findings.summary: Env-var and file Sources bypass the separator config because PostParse calls f.Set directly without setMultiValueParsingConfig, so slice/map flags from Sources ignore custom separators (e.g. "a;b" parses as one item, "k:v" fails).
Subcommands do not inherit separator settings (SliceFlagSeparator, DisableSliceFlagSeparator, MapFlagKeyValueSeparator) from parent/root commands, so they silently fall back to defaults.
disableSliceFlagSeparator is now a constant false used only by tests; it is dead code and can be removed.
New tests only cover CLI-arg parsing on a single root command; env-source and subcommand cases are untested.
